stories.headline: Why Peloton Stock Popped Today
stories.body: Key PointsTraders are driving up Peloton's stock price ahead of its inclusion in a leading small-cap index.

stories.headline: OpenAI and MoonPay Let ChatGPT Users Buy Crypto Without Leaving Chats
stories.body: Crypto payments company MoonPay is now live in ChatGPT’s App Store. “We are officially the first and only crypto onramp integrated in ChatGPT,” the company said in a Friday (May 22) post on X. stories.headline: Amerant names new CEO, Illinois community banks agree to merge
stories.body: Amerant Bancorp in Coral Gables, Florida, appointed Carlos Iafigliola its permanent president and CEO; Morton Community Bank in Illinois reached a deal to buy a three-branch franchise in the Land of Lincoln; Bank First in Manitowoc, Wisconsin, agreed to acquire PSB Holdings; and more in this week's banking news roundup.
